reason: The money isn't the issue, $35 or even $79 is nothing next to one bad cement order. But I'm not adding some bot I've never heard of to the group where my guys talk about suppliers, cash and site problems, and I'm not linking my Google account to it either. Maybe I'd forward it a few receipts myself to see what happens, but then I'm the one doing the typing again, and that's the whole thing I don't want.
objection: It says it only takes payment documents, but to pick them out it still has to read every message in the work chat. Who's behind it, where do my numbers end up, and what happens if it gets hacked or sold? 'Trust us' from a Telegram bot doesn't cut it when my partner sees these figures.
would_change_my_mind: Another contractor here in Bali I know telling me they've run it on their site chats for a few months with no problems, plus a real company name and a clear statement of what it stores and deletes.
